title: Edge Research Platform Program

authority.note: This program tracks design/implementation/review/test/validation. It does not grant model or trading authority.

goal.primary: Maximize P(find a small number of cost-surviving, deployable edges OR cleanly prove the current information set cannot produce them) per unit calendar time and capital risk.
not_goals: Maximize number of models or features
Treat existence of CRT/Gaussian/Zone/RR/BitNet/TradeNet as proof of edge
Trust backtest numbers before validation-flow review

trust_policy.rule: Do NOT trust backtest data, ledgers, PF/E/WR numbers, or qualification verdicts until the validation flow that consumed them has been reviewed and confirmed to match the intended implementation.
applies_to: any PF, expectancy, win-rate, or trade-count claims used for decisions
required_before_trust: Identify which validation/entry path was consumed (gate-ON vs gate-OFF, CRT-only vs fusion, label source)
Review that path against intended implementation (code + config + ACTIVE_VERSION)
Confirm no lookahead / contaminated labels / wrong exit model / wrong cost model for the claim being made
Record validation_flow_review status on the work item before treating results as evidence

status_tokens.UNTRUSTED_RAW: Artifacts exist; validation flow not reviewed
status_tokens.FLOW_REVIEWED: Consumed validation path inspected and documented
status_tokens.FLOW_MATCHES_INTENT: Path matches intended implementation; numbers may be used as research evidence only
status_tokens.AUTHORITY_ELIGIBLE: Survived qualification gates + Authority Ladder; still not automatic production authority

lifecycle_phases.description: Pre-register hypotheses, populations, targets, controls, kill criteria. No RUN authority by default.
Surgical code/config/data plumbing only after design freeze or explicit owner grant.
Independent technical review of design and/or implementation vs intent (including validation flow).
Unit/integration/regression floors; determinism; parity. Not economic truth.
Economic/scientific validation under frozen protocol. Results stay UNTRUSTED_RAW until trust_policy satisfied.

conversation_log.topic: Trace Geometry — organize the population by shape (clusters), and parallelize the build
conversation_log.summary: Owner's next milestone: organize the 23k-trace population into mathematically-similar REGIONS before any LLM interpretation. Built trace_geometry.py (StandardScaler + KMeans, k chosen by subsampled silhouette over {4,6,8,10,12}; cluster library = size/family/centroid/outcome-distribution/feature-signature/representatives) extending the F-023 cluster_morphology pattern. Switched clustering to a dimensionless MORPHOLOGY feature set (excluded 15 absolute price-level features: raw OHLC/EMA/MACD/swing/body/wick) because raw price variance over gold's 2400->4500 trajectory otherwise splits on price regime, not shape. Result: k=4, clusters = bearish-structure / mild-bullish / strong-momentum / a distinct liquidity-sweep region (liquidity_sweep z=+3.75) — but outcome distributions are ~UNIFORM across all (SL 66-68% / TP 31-33%): a clean descriptive re-confirmation of F-023 (morphology separates SHAPE, not expectancy; no cluster is a signal). Also parallelized build_trace_corpus.py (--jobs: parallel forward_walk; detection stays in-order; --jobs 1 = run_instrument reference), PROVEN byte-identical (--jobs 1 == --jobs 4, 23,446 toy traces). No GPU (research ETL, not matmul).
decisions: Clusters are NOT edges (F-023); cluster outcome distributions are descriptive population structure, never promotable signals (§6.5)
Cluster on dimensionless SHAPE features by default (price-level features excluded; --features all opt-in) so geometry = morphology, not price regime
Parallelism MUST be byte-identical to sequential (determinism gate) — the F-series findings depend on deterministic corpora; proven --jobs 1 == --jobs 4
No GPU now (occasional CPU research ETL); no pyarrow (npz/JSONL); LLM interpretation of clusters deferred (proposals only, ERP-validated)

conversation_log.topic: Trace k-NN similarity graph — the sharpest F-023 confirmation (no LOCAL outcome structure)
conversation_log.summary: Built trace_knn.py (descriptive per-trace k-NN graph in the same standardized morphology space as the clusters, reusing geometry.npz Xs + cluster_assignments + ReplaySimilarityIndex.aggregate_top_k_stats; batch graph via sklearn NearestNeighbors because the replay index's per-query scan doesn't scale to 23k^2). k=10, cosine: neighbourhood same-outcome concordance mean 0.5498 vs random baseline 0.5459; neighbourhood TP-rate 0.3149 vs global 0.3176 — a trace's 10 nearest morphological neighbours share its outcome at the RANDOM rate. Finest-resolution re-confirmation of F-023. SCOPE (E-001 correction 2026-07-16): the measured null is 'static entry-state OHLCV morphology did not discriminate outcomes on this corpus' — NOT a claim about UNMEASURED information classes (temporal/HTF/execution/order-flow/macro/alt-data; see erp-information-class-boundary.md, RC-005..010 OPEN). Also fixed the flaky determinism test (was a ~10-min subprocess full-build that timed out) -> fast in-process kernel-equivalence check (_fw_worker == forward_walk on sampled real signals); full byte-identity kept as a documented manual command.
decisions: Neighbourhoods are NOT edges (F-023); local outcome-concordance ≈ random baseline = no local structure; descriptive only (§6.5)
Reuse replay_similarity_index aggregation + cosine concept; use sklearn NearestNeighbors for the scalable batch graph (per-query scan / 2GB cosine matrix don't scale)
Determinism regression = fast in-process kernel-equivalence (not a 10-min full-corpus subprocess); byte-identity proven manually + documented command
LLM interpretation of cluster/neighbourhood summaries deferred (proposals only, ERP-validated, never promoted)
